title: spermacoce limae
intro: Spermacoce limae, commonly known as Guaco, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family, native to tropical America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of Spermacoce limae, but it has been traditionally used to relieve coughs, fever, and other respiratory symptoms.
